description.value: Sushi Street is a Japanese takeout restaurant inside King George Hub at the King George SkyTrain Station in Surrey, offering a broad menu of sashimi, nigiri, rolls, bento boxes, tempura, teriyaki, and ready-to-eat foods. The transit-adjacent location and emphasis on quick, convenient service make it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the area. Online ordering and delivery through Skip the Dishes and Uber Eats are available, and catering services are offered for larger groups.
